# Devin CLI Knowledge Base Index

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:sync:devin-cli`. Do not edit manually. -->

The `docs/devin-cli/` directory is an exact local mirror of the Devin CLI pages listed in [the official documentation index](https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt).
When answering Devin CLI questions, consult the corresponding local mirror document first.

## Routing index

### Getting started & core usage

- [Quickstart](devin-cli/index.md): Get up and running in 2 minutes with Devin CLI, a local command-line coding agent with deep Devin Cloud integration.
- [Essential Commands](devin-cli/essential-commands.md): If you remember nothing else...
- [Subagents](devin-cli/subagents.md): Delegate tasks to independent subagents that work in the foreground or background
- [Hand off to cloud Devins](devin-cli/handoff.md): Hand off a task from the Devin CLI to a cloud Devin session with /handoff.
- [Models](devin-cli/models.md): Available models and how to configure them
- [Adaptive](devin-cli/adaptive.md): Adaptive is Cognition's intelligent model router that automatically selects the best AI model for each task.
- [Sandbox](devin-cli/sandbox.md): OS-level isolation for Devin CLI sessions: how the sandbox works, network filtering, and enterprise enforcement.
- [Troubleshooting](devin-cli/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and how to fix them

### IDE integration (ACP)

- [JetBrains](devin-cli/acp/jetbrains.md): Run Devin inside JetBrains IDEs from AI Chat using the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), including JetBrains Remote Development.
- [Zed](devin-cli/acp/zed.md): Run Devin CLI inside the Zed editor as a custom ACP agent in the Agent Panel.
- [Xcode](devin-cli/acp/xcode.md): Run Devin inside Xcode's coding assistant via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), or give the Devin CLI access to your Xcode project through Xcode's MCP bridge.
